issue_context.title: release-7.5 branch bump https://github.com/pingcap/errors to the latest commit hash
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

tiflow release-7.5 bump tidb dependency to the commit-hash `9d27eef90bbb`, the `github.com/pingcap/errors` is bumped to `v0.11.5-0.20240318064555-6bd07397691f` automatically.

but on the tidb release-7.5 branch `9d27eef90bbb`, the `errors` package commit-hash is `v0.11.5-0.20221009092201-b66cddb77c32`, they are inconsistent.

Error reported:
```
# github.com/pingcap/tidb/br/pkg/redact
../pkg/mod/github.com/pingcap/tidb@v1.1.0-beta.0.20240522064147-9d27eef90bbb/br/pkg/redact/redact.go:14:32: cannot use redactLog (variable of type bool) as string value in argument to errors.RedactLogEnabled.Store
../pkg/mod/github.com/pingcap/tidb@v1.1.0-beta.0.20240522064147-9d27eef90bbb/br/pkg/redact/redact.go:19:9: cannot use errors.RedactLogEnabled.Load() (value of type string) as bool value in return statement
```
comments: I think the bug is fixed. If you still have problems, feel free to reopen it.

review_comments: current master don't call `TiDBOptOn`, which doesn't support `MARKER`, see https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/9657f0631686a346e2a7f5d22d6e640df7499bb3/pkg/sessionctx/variable/sysvar.go#L2283-L2284

* https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/51642

This PR is not cherry-pick back to the release-7.5 branch, so still use `TIDBOptOn`
